sources.snippet: We therefore design the training data so that the model must look at the video, and look at it several times, before it answers. HopChain addresses this weakness on images with multi-hop data synthesis.

sources.title: Video-HopChain: Multi-Hop Questions and Confidence-Gated Exploration ...
sources.snippet: The dataset adapts the multi-hop idea from HopChain to video, where evidence is distributed across time. Every question includes at least one hop involving two moments, and selector questions use an earlier answer to choose which later moment to inspect.
